day_local: Isniinta Toddobaadka Labaad iyo Tobnaad ee Waqtiga Caadiga ah
greeting: Magaca Aabbaha iyo Wiilka iyo Ruuxa Quduuska ah. Nabadda Rabbigeenna Ciise Masiix ha idinla jirto.
penitential: Rabbiyow, naxariiso. Masiixow, naxariiso. Rabbiyow, naxariiso.
psalm_response: Magaca Rabbiga ha lagu ammaano weligiis.
homily:
Waxaa jira saacado maalinta ka mid ah, gaar ahaan marka qorraxdu ay bilaabato inay hoos u dhacdo, oo gurigu uu noqdo mid aamusan, halkaas oo xusuusta ay si tartiib ah u soo gasho qolka. Waxaad arkeysaa wax yar oo maalinle ah: laga yaabee inay tahay xadhigga kabaha oo si qaldan u yaalla, ama buug uu Ben dhigay miiska, ama xataa sawirka diyaarad uu sida aadka ah u jeclaa oo weli derbiga sudhan. Waxyaalahan yaryar, oo aan muhiim u muuqan, ayaa ah meesha aan maanta ka bilaabayno. Waxay yihiin xusuus muujinaysa in nolosha Benjamin Vo ay ahayd mid dhab ah, mid qurux badan, oo weli halkan nala joogta.

Waxaan dooraneynaa hal sawir oo maanta nala socda: waa 'xornimada wiilka'. Bawlos, akhriska koowaad, wuxuu inoo sheegayaa: 'Waayo, xornimada aawadeed ayuu Masiixu inoo xoreeyey; sidaas darteed adkaada, hana u dhiibina mar kale harqoodka addoonsiga.' Bal ka feker sawirkaas. Xornimadu ma aha oo kaliya inaan samayno waxaan rabno; waa inaan ku noolaano jacaylka Ilaah oo aan ka xoroowno cabsidii iyo xanuunkii adduunka. Ben wuxuu ahaa wiil 'xur' u ahaa inuu jacaylkaas ku noolaado. Xusuusnow sida uu u dhisayey barnaamijyadiisa kombuyuutarka, sida uu ugu qorayey koodhka GitHub, ama sida uu ugu taabtay nolosha dadka kale jacayl aan xad lahayn. Ben wuxuu lahaa qalbi u taagnaa abuuridda, dhisidda, iyo jacaylka. Wuxuu xirtay xornimadaas markii uu u sheegay waalidkiis inuu doonayo inuu bixiyo dhammaan lacagta piggy bank-giisa si uu u caawiyo adeerkiis William. Ma uusan jebin sanduuqa, mana loo baahnayn, laakiin rabitaankaas saafi ah ee ahaa inuu dhiibo wax kasta oo uu haysto waa dabeecadda wiilkan qalbiga wanaagsan. Taasi waa waxa ay ka dhigan tahay in lagu dhex noolaado xornimada Masiixa.

Laakiin intaanan halkaas sii marin, waa inaan si daacad ah u wajahno xanuunka. Alan iyo Thao, waan ogahay in saddexdan bilood ay ahaayeen kuwo adag. Waxaa jira waqtiyo aad dareemaysaan in xanuunka uu ka weyn yahay iftiinka. Waxaad is-weydiinaysaan: 'Maxaan seegnay? Ma jirtay wax aynu si kale u samayn karin?' Waxaan rabaa inaan halkan ku hakinno. Waxaan rabaa inaan idiin sheego runta: Ma jiro wax aad seegnay. Ma jiro qof eed leh. Cudurku ma aha ciqaab, mana aha guuldarro waalid. Sida Ciise uga jawaabay su'aashii ku saabsanayd ninkii indhoolaha ahaa: 'Ma aha ninkan iyo waalidkiis toona.' Ilaah ma eedeeyo, mana aha in aad adinkuna is-eedaysaan. Xanuunka halkan yaalla waa mid dhab ah, laakiin culayskaas ma ahan mid aad adinku keenteen. Waxaad siiseen Ben jacayl aan xad lahayn, waalidnimadiinuna waxay ahayd hadiyad uu Ben ku koray. Ha is-eedeynin; Ilaah wuu idin jecel yahay, Ben-na wuxuu ku jiraa gacmaha Aabbaha oo aanay jirin wax dhib ah. Ilaah ma rabo in aad ku noolaataan harqoodka eedda; wuxuu idin rabaa in aad xor u noqotaan jacaylkiisa.

Oo halkaas ayay nuurku ka soo galayaa qolka mugdiga ah. Injiilka maanta, Ciise wuxuu inoo sheegayaa: 'Waxaa jira wax ka weyn Sulaymaan halkan.' Haa, jacaylka Ilaah ee Ben waa ka weyn yahay wax kasta oo dunidan ka jira. Ben wuxuu ahaa wiil maqlay ereyga Ilaah. Wuxuu ahaa wiil aaminsan in 'isku daygu uu yahay waxa kaliya ee muhiimka ah'. Hadda, Ben wuxuu ku jiraa meel ka sarreysa daruuraha, meel aanay jirin xanuun ama daal. Wuxuu ku jiraa 'Banquet of Heaven'. Ma jiro baahi loo qabo inuu dhisayo 'con chim airlines', waayo wuxuu ku jiraa meel uu ka arki karo adduunka oo dhan, isagoo dhoola caddaynaya. Wuxuu xor ka yahay wax walba oo xanuun ah.

Ryan, walaal qaali ah, waan ogahay in mararka qaarkood aad dareemeyso in kursigaaga agtiisa uu yahay mid cidlo ah. Laakiin xusuuso in Ben uu ku jiro xusuustaada, riyooyinkaaga, iyo jacaylka aad wadaagteen. Ha ka cabsin inaad horay u socoto. Ben wuxuu rabaa inaad noqoto wiilka geesiga ah ee uu mar walba jeclaa. Wuxuu rabaa inaad ku raaxaysato nolosha, waayo adiga iyo isaga waxaa idin mideeyay jacayl aan dhimanayn. Ben wuxuu idin leeyahay: 'Ha ka baqina, waayo waxaan idin sugayaa meel aan dhimasho lahayn.'

Markaad maanta ka baxaysaan meeshan, qaada hal shay oo yar oo aad gacanta ku haysaan: Ha is-edeynin, hana ka cabsanin inaad u dhiibto xanuunkaaga Ilaah. Ben wuxuu hadda ku sugan yahay nabadda gacmaha Aabbaha. Marka aad dareento cidlo, xusuuso in jacaylka Masiixa uu weli idin daboolayo, iyagoo idin xusuusinaya in jacaylku uu weligiis noolaan doono. Ben wuxuu idin leeyahay inaan la idin iloobin. Ilaah wuu idin jecel yahay, Ben-na wuxuu idin jecel yahay. Aamiin.
spiritual_communion: Ciise, waxaan rumeysanahay inaad ku sugan tahay Sacrament-ka Quduuska ah. Waxaan kuu jecelahay wax kasta oo kale, waxaana rabaa inaan naftayda kuugu dhiibo. Maadaama aanan hadda Sacrament-ka kugu qaadan karin, fadlan qalbigayga ku soo gal si ruuxi ah. Waxaan kugu soo dhaweynayaa sidii adigoo horey u joogay, waxaana naftayda gebi ahaanba kuu dhiibayaa. Weligaa ha ii oggolaan inaan kaa go'o. Aamiin.
closing: Rabbigu ha idin barakeeyo, ha idin ilaaliyo, oo ha idin siiyo nabaddiisa weligeed ah. Aamiin.
petition_call: Waxaan Rabbiga u baryeynaa inuu maqlo codkeenna.
standing_petitions: Wiilkeenna qaaliga ah ee Ben iyo dhammaan kuwii naga horreeyay, inuu Rabbigu siiyo nabad iyo iftiin weligiis ah.
Dhammaan qoysaska murugaysan, inuu Ilaah u soo dejiyo raaxo, xoog, iyo rajo cusub oo ku saabsan nolosha weligeed ah.

readings.label: Akhriska Koowaad
readings.text: Walaalayaal, waxaa qoran in Ibraahim uu lahaa laba wiil, mid uu u dhalay addoon, midna uu u dhalay naag xor ah. Wiilka addoonka waxaa loo dhalay si dabiici ah, kii naagta xorta ahna waxaa loo dhalay ballanqaad aawadiis. Tani waa tusaale. Haweenkani waxay matalaan laba axdi. Midkii Buurta Siinay wuxuu dhalay carruur addoonsi ah; taasi waa Haajar. Laakiin Yeruusaalemta sare waa xor, iyaduna waa hooyadeen. Waayo waxaa qoran: 'Farax, adiga oo madhalays ah oo aan carruur dhalin; qayli oo ku dhawaaq, adiga oo aan foolan; waayo carruurta tii cidlayntu way ka badan yihiin kuwa tii ninka qabta.' Sidaas darteed, walaalayaal, innagu ma nihin carruurta addoonka, ee waxaan nahay carruurta naagta xorta ah. Xornimada aawadeed ayuu Masiixu inoo xoreeyey; sidaas darteed adkaada, hana u dhiibina mar kale harqoodka addoonsiga.

readings.label: Sabuurka
readings.text: R. Magaca Rabbiga ha lagu ammaano weligiis. Ammaana, idinka oo ah addoommada Rabbiga, ammaana magaca Rabbiga. Magaca Rabbiga ha lagu ammaano haatan iyo weligiisba. R. Magaca Rabbiga ha lagu ammaano weligiis. Meesha qorraxdu ka soo baxdo ilaa meesha ay u dhacdo, magaca Rabbiga ha lagu ammaano. Rabbigu wuxuu ka sarreeyaa quruumaha oo dhan; ammaantiisu waxay ka sarreysaa samooyinka. R. Magaca Rabbiga ha lagu ammaano weligiis. Ayaa la mid ah Rabbiga Ilaaheenna ah, oo samooyinka iyo dhulka hoose eega? Wuxuu kuwa hooseeya ka soo qaadaa boodhka; wuxuuna masaakiinta ka soo bixiyaa qashinka.

readings.label: Injiilka
readings.text: Markii dad badan ay isugu yimaadeen, Ciise wuxuu ku yidhi, 'Jiilkani waa jiil shar leh; wuxuu raadinayaa calaamad, laakiin calaamad kale looma siin doono, marka laga reebo calaamadda Yoonis. Sida Yoonis uu calaamad ugu noqday reer Ninawa, sidaas oo kale ayuu Wiilka Aadanuhu u noqon doonaa jiilkan. Xukunka maalintiis, boqoraddii koonfureed way kici doontaa iyadoo la jirta dadka jiilkan, wayna xukumi doontaa, maxaa yeelay waxay ka timid darafyada dhulka si ay u maqasho xigmaddii Sulaymaan, halkan waxaa jooga wax ka weyn Sulaymaan. Xukunka maalintiis, dadka reer Ninawa way kici doonaan iyagoo la jira jiilkan, wayna xukumi doonaan, maxaa yeelay markii Yoonis uu wacdiyey ayay toobad keeneen, halkan waxaa jooga wax ka weyn Yoonis.'

day: Monday of the Twenty-eighth Week in Ordinary Time

pet_prayers.text: Ben ơi, trong giấc ngủ anh Huy đã thấy Ben về thăm anh, trao cho anh lời cầu nguyện để hai anh em mình lại được tìm thấy nhau. Xin Chúa thương nhậm lời Ben, cho Ben được hưởng ngàn thu bình an bên Chúa. Nếu có thể, xin Ben lại ghé thăm anh trong những giấc mơ tiếp theo nhé, dù chỉ là một lời chào hay một nụ cười thân thương như ngày nào.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Ben, my sweet boy, I miss you so much. Thank you for visiting me and Chú Chris last night. He told me he saw you flying a helicopter—so free, joyful, and strong up there. Down here, Mom and I are crying more and more each day. A piece of my heart feels completely dead without you, Ben. Please watch over us, pray for your mom, your brother Ryan, and me, and give us the strength to keep going. We love you forever

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Today marks 100 days without you. Miss you a whole a lot Ben. Feel free to visit any time! See you around buddy! Love you!

Ben ơi, nay anh M đi xử lý hồ sơ ở Cam Ranh, đi ngang qua Cam Ranh Airport. Rồi cuộc nói chuyện về máy bay của Ben lại ùa về, nhớ nhiều kỷ niệm về Ben lắm ( anh M sẽ giữ kín kakaka). Quỷ nhỏ, tự nhiên nghĩ về mày buồn dễ sợ. Hãy đi đến những nơi mà Ben muốn nha và đừng quên là luôn nhớ về gia đình mình nhé, thương em trai nhiều. Giá như !!!!!!!!!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: What happened my son? It's been 3 months since you left us. Missing you so much my whole body aches. Mom cries every day now... What are we going to do now Ben?  Please pray for us.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text:
Hey Ben,

Rafael Rizzo and his little brother Ben really need your help right now. Please bless them with good health and give them the strength to get through this together. Please watch over Brandon and Flor's health, too.

I miss you a whole bunch. I know you're up in heaven watching over all of us. Whenever you're able to, stop by to visit, yeah? I love you and miss you so much!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text:
Hey Ben - Miss you a whole bunch. Crying all day yesterday, i hope today will be better. Please guide our family through this grief... There's a 14 year old boy that just left earth on August 12... His name is Phero Aden Vo - look for him, maybe you guys can be friends...

Please pray for me and mom to have good health and strength.

I love and miss you Ben
